name: KUNG 攻 HORIZON 天际 complete bike
why_interesting: KUNG's own June 2026 post lists a full-carbon HORIZON 天际 entry complete bike from CNY 6,999 with Shimano 105 R7120 hydraulic, REGO 50 mm carbon wheels and a FEO carbon integrated bar, matching the retained CNY 6,999 card.

facts.frame_material: Full-carbon HORIZON disc frame and fork (KUNG post: 天际碳纤维碟刹车架)
facts.drivetrain: Shimano 105 R7120 mechanical 2×12 with hydraulic disc brakes on the CNY 6,999 entry complete bike (KUNG post graphic: SHIMANO R7120油碟大套)
facts.wheels: REGO STANDARD 50 mm carbon disc wheels with Continental Ultra Sport tires
facts.cockpit: KUNG FEO one-piece carbon bar; FEO carbon-rail saddle
facts.bottom_bracket: T47 (景晔 T47 in the entry build)
facts.stiffness_evidence: No transferable current-generation numeric stiffness result or sufficiently specific independent assessment was found across the 50-area sweep or the October 2026 XHS review

source_note: The retained card supplies the CNY 6,999 complete-bike lead and visible HORIZON frame. KUNG's own XHS post (30 June 2026) lists the full-carbon entry complete bike from CNY 6,999 in white or black (CNY 7,799 in 星空 art paint) with Shimano R7120 hydraulic, REGO 50 mm carbon wheels, FEO bar and saddle, Continental Ultra Sport tires and a T47 bottom bracket; the retained card most likely shows this build, but its exact SKU is not printed. JD's 2026-08-30 index listed KUNG 攻 / HORIZON 天际 builds across multiple distinct trims, and the October flagship index also lists R7170 and FEO DISC builds and framesets. The 2018 review is an older generation and does not supply current weight, clearance, or stiffness evidence.

enrichment_reviews.scope: Brand-published entry complete-bike BOM and starting prices; dealer price ranges kept as qualitative notes. The retained 2026-08-08 price observation is unchanged.
